result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly functional, but there are a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and card clipping.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is cut off at the right edge, with the restaurant name truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scroll carousels, but ensure the partially visible card clearly hints at scrollability and text truncation uses an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the ramen card is a white outline, while the heart on the pizza card below has a dark/filled background, creating visual inconsistency between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling across all restaurant cards for a consistent appearance.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the fold/navigation bar, showing only the discount badge and image without the restaurant name or details.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but verify content below is fully accessible when scrolling and not obscured by the bottom navigation.
